name: harness-marketplace
description: harness — spec-driven development enforcement for autonomous coding agents. Skills guide the workflow, hooks bind the rules, a framework-agnostic engine decides.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Development enforcement plugin: explore-first design with decision cards, verification-first slices (a red record at start, statement coverage at close), deterministic gates G1, G3, G5, G6, G9 and G10, a capped context injection, shared team memory and an STE-80 text checker. Skills: /harness:explore, /harness:architect, /harness:design-review, /harness:adr-authoring, /harness:verification, /harness:backlog, /harness:build, /harness:review, /harness:close-slice, /harness:init and /harness:harness, plus 4 agent personas.
